# were generated 2026-09-23 by round-tripping hand-built
# FreePlaySize objects - not hand-typed slugs - through the real
# decodeFreePlaySize/encodeFreePlaySize in src/sim/freePlayTopologies.ts, via a
# throwaway tsx script (not checked in) equivalent to:
#   import { encodeFreePlaySize, decodeFreePlaySize } from '../src/sim/freePlayTopologies';
#   function dump(type, size) {
#     const raw = encodeFreePlaySize(size);
#     const decoded = decodeFreePlaySize(type, raw);
#     const reencoded = encodeFreePlaySize(decoded);
#     console.log(`SIZE ${raw} => ${reencoded} :: ${JSON.stringify(decoded)}`);
#   }
#   dump('single-dc', { brokersPerZone: [10], partitions: 1, replicationFactor: 1,
#     extraTopics: [{ name: 'wal', partitions: 4, replicationFactor: 3, minInSyncReplicas: 1, cleanupPolicy: 'delete', disklessEnable: true }] });
#   // ...then a second extraTopics entry {name:'classic', ...} (no disklessEnable),
#   // then primaryDiskless:true alone, then + disklessTiming:{commitIntervalMs:250,uploadMs:600},
#   // then disklessTiming:{uploadMs:900} with no primaryDiskless (an extra topic
#   // carries the diskless flag instead) - see mapping/size_test.go's matching
#   // TestBuildSize cases for the exact FreePlaySize shape of each line, in order.
# Run via `npx tsx <script>.ts` from the website repo root; delete the script
# after copying its "SIZE ..." stdout lines here (it is not a permanent
# generator - ts-fixtures.txt as a whole is a manual, point-in-time dump; see
# the file header above).

# 2026-09-24 (Task C): mcpserver/shape.go gained shape.disklessTiming, exposing
# the SAME session-wide tail-index-17 timing that mapping/size.go's
# disklessTail already encoded (via the new exported mapping.EncodeDisklessTail
# helper both packages now call). No new SIZE lines were generated for it - the
# two "primary diskless flag with timing" / "diskless timing only, upload side"
# lines above already pin the exact slugs mcpserver/shape_test.go's new
# TestShapeDocExamples cases assert, for the same broker/topic shapes. Task C
# also looked at producer/consumer-group `client.rack` (KIP-1163 draft) parity
# per task-B-report.md - neither mapping/size.go nor mcpserver/shape.go encode
# producers or consumer groups at all (no size-slug tail index 1/2 codec exists
# in this Go tool), so there was nothing to mirror it onto; see the "What is
# NOT represented" note in docs/mapping.md.
# 2026-09-24 (final-review fix): diskless-3az's preset topic (`clicks`) is
# diskless on its own, with no caller topic ever setting disklessEnable -
# clampDisklessFields' "kept only when some topic is diskless" check counts
# templateTopics(type, ...), so disklessTiming alone is accepted for this
# preset. 2026-10-14: that line is a diskless-3az line, and single-dc drops a
# timing with no diskless topic (it decodes to plain `6x3x3` there), so it no
# longer reads as a `SIZE` (single-dc) line. It is regenerated below, with a second
# one carrying both timings, as `SIZE-DISKLESS-3AZ` lines: each is
# decodeFreePlaySize('diskless-3az', <raw>) then encodeFreePlaySize on the result,
# run through the real simulator codec by a throwaway tsx script (not checked in).
# mapping.TestBuildSize* replay only the `SIZE` lines; mcpserver replays these.

# EncodePrimaryConfigTail). The simulator's clampPrimaryTopic drops a primary min.ISR
# equal to defaultPrimaryMinIsr(rf) = max(1, rf-1) and a cleanup of `delete`, and

# 2026-11-13 (v2.3 diskless implementations): SIZE-IMPL <type> <raw> => <slug> :: <json size>
#   = decodeFreePlaySize(<type>, <raw>) then encodeFreePlaySize on the result, via a
#   throwaway tsx script (not checked in) run from the website repo root, for the
#   inkless-3az, kafscale-3b and automq-3az presets. Lines whose sides differ show what
#   the playground rewrites: a primary diskless flag `d` is dropped on all three, a
#   commit interval is dropped on kafscale-3b, RF is clamped to 1 on kafscale-3b and
#   automq-3az, and an extra topic there always gets the diskless `~1`.
#   mcpserver.TestShapeImplMatchesTypeScriptFixtures replays the right-hand slugs.
